remarks: Tucked into the woods of North Stamford this custom designed 2 story ranch is the epitome of sophistication, luxury and comfort on 2 plus peaceful acres on a cul de sac with 3 homes. This exquisite residence provides the convenience of one level living, and an open floor plan which is wonderful for entertaining. The home has 5 bdrms, 4.5 bths & more than 4,500 sq ft of above grade living. The heart of the home is the large fam rm, which is open to the kitchen, has vaulted ceiling, a beautiful stone wall, a wood burning fpl & sliders to a large deck. The eat in kitchen has a center island, granite tops, cooktop with a built-in grill, 2 wall ovens, refrigerator with ice maker & a warming oven. Off the kitchen is the formal dining & living rms. On one side of the home is the primary bedrm suite & 2 addit bedrms. The primary bedrm incl a walk in closet, full bath , skylight, double sink, jacuzzi tub & separate shower. The 2 bedrms share a full bath. On the other side of the home is the 4th bedrm with a full bath & the laundry room Access to the 2-car garage is on the main level. The low lev is above grade, and is very special. It has a large recreation/game rm on 2 levels with sliders to the stone patio. The 5th bedrm, full bath, gym, storage & utility room & crawl space complete the low lev. Other features include zone c/a, hardwd flrs & carpeting throughout the main level, a whole home generator, upgraded deck, newer driveway, central vac, 2 new oil tanks & a stone patio.
